result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on your business size, location, and whether you need payroll only or a complete payroll and HR system.

**My recommendation: Gusto is a strong all-round choice for small businesses in the US.** However, if your business is in Australia, I would recommend looking at Australian payroll platforms instead, because local tax, superannuation and Single Touch Payroll (STP) compliance are essential.

Here are the leading options to consider.

## Best payroll software compared

2026 recommendations

| Software | Best for |
|--------|--------|
| Gusto | Best overall for US small businesses |
| Xero | Accounting and payroll integration |
| QuickBooks Payroll | Businesses already using QuickBooks |
| Employment Hero | Australian businesses and HR |
| ADP RUN | Growing businesses |
| Rippling | Payroll, HR and automation |


US-based comparisons consistently rate Gusto highly for ease of use and its combination of payroll, tax filing and HR features. [fitsmallbusiness.com](https://fitsmallbusiness.com/best-payroll-software-reviews/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[technologyadvice.com](https://technologyadvice.com/payroll-software/?KBOpenTab=undefined&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/select/best-payroll-services-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## If you're operating in Australia

These are the platforms I'd shortlist\:

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

Best if you want accounting and payroll together. Supports Australian payroll workflows, STP and superannuation.

Ideal for small businesses already using Xero.

[Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

Best for payroll combined with HR, employee onboarding, leave management and workforce administration.

Ideal for businesses with employees and growing teams.

[Employment Hero Australia](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. MYOB**

A well-established Australian accounting and payroll option, with employee payments, payroll reporting and STP capabilities.

Ideal for traditional small businesses.

[MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/V7ncQizfgbGQElQkc938sgaMM7ZEQv1NHHYAzk3Nx-WFL6-OJYGbvAnFNuzMC0fAQKgcSzHML_x1vJSEw8FYxBmYG5VErcHXh1QShDQqcUY2KxN1qql7Wsk31a8NeQnNV-pwEGnikgeaYvZR-1vgG5oTi-1EBFosMokMclJnmg84_vF0N18AbKuILSiMTR1x?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. KeyPay \(found within Employment Hero Payroll)**

Strong payroll functionality, award interpretation and workforce management capabilities.

Ideal for businesses with complex award rates and rosters.

[Employment Hero Payroll](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

## My recommendation

For a small Australian business, I'd narrow it down this way\:

- **Xero\:** Best if you already use Xero accounting and have straightforward wages.
- **MYOB\:** Worth considering if you have four or fewer employees and want inexpensive standalone payroll.
- **Employment Hero\:** Best if you have casual staff, complex awards, overtime, weekend rates or rosters.

One important consideration: Australian payroll needs to account for STP Phase 2, PAYG withholding, superannuation and applicable Modern Awards. Payday Super also commenced on 1 July 2026. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
